page_title: Lovino — AI Image & Video Generator (formerly LensGo)

summary.name: Lovino
summary.one_liner: Lovino (formerly LensGo) is an AI image and video generator for product photos, ads, social posts and short videos from text prompts or your own photos.
use_cases: create product photos without a photoshoot
make UGC-style video ads for TikTok and Reels
generate social media posts and carousels
compare multiple AI image and video models in one place
make short AI videos from a text prompt
copy prompts from example AI images
summary.what_it_does: Lovino lets users create AI images and short videos from a text prompt or their own photos. It gives access to 50+ image and video models (including Flux, Veo, Seedance, GPT Image, Kling and Imagen 4) under a single prompt bar and credit balance. An assistant called Iris plans shots, writes prompts and selects a model for each. It includes a UGC Studio for turning a product photo into creator-style video ads, a Studio for choosing models per job, and a Made with Lovino gallery where each image shows the prompt that produced it. The page also mentions an iPhone app that shares the same account and credits.
notable: 50+ image and video models under one credit system
Iris assistant plans shots and picks the model
UGC Studio turns a product photo into creator-style video ads
Formerly LensGo; the listing notes LensGo was shut down in 2025
caveats: Free plan gives 3 credits per day and images carry a watermark; watermark-free commercial use requires a paid plan
Paid plans range from $7.99 to $44.99 per month
Video generation and Motion Control use paid credits
Nudity, sexual content and real faces without consent are disallowed and prompts are screened
